title: Website backups and bandwidth use
problem: Merchants couldn’t back up their website or see how much bandwidth it uses.
now: Back up, download and restore the website and settings, ask to restore a nightly backup, and see bandwidth against the plan.
steps: Open Settings › Hosting › Backups and press Back up now.
notes: Where: Settings › Hosting › Backups and Usage (/set-hosting?tab=backups)
